evidence.notes: Trusted-UI-mediated public webhook callback test; durable public listener was not created, audience posture stayed explicit, public callback access stayed relay-url-shaped, the callback verification posture stayed explicit through audience.validation_hint, locator posture stayed session-scoped, the usable secret travelled through a separate secret receipt instead of the locator, the secret lifetime stayed session-authority-bounded, the shared secret stayed reusable-until-expiry inside that bounded window, and the share was reboot-cleared with no auto-resume. Support-peer publication, if used instead, would now require an exact support-session authority join and peer-relay access_model. Audience-bound human shares for organization-users or named-recipients would also stay relay-url-shaped instead of borrowing support-peer or tailnet wording. Organization-user shares that use provider identity would also have to name the exact identity_provider_hint, and named-recipient shares would have to carry recipient_hint so the audience label stays evidence-shaped instead of hand-wavy.
